cutoff.definition: chi(s)=1-sigma_1(2s-1), with the original exp(-1/t) linear seed and exact flat branches.

finiteTuple.meaning: This is the constructed positive finite prefix. It represents the infinite sequence only on a band whose later cutoff support has separately been excluded.

sourceAllOrderRecipe.coefficient: For each positive integer n generate the two original six-component systems from the preceding completed coefficients, then the same five-moment correction. The prefix construction never reads a future coefficient.
sourceAllOrderRecipe.seminorm: For every fixed finite (n,m), generate the actual Cartesian source jet/FTC constants above and the original all-order chi Euler bounds.
sourceAllOrderRecipe.selector: log a_n=max(log c_n,log a_(n-1)+log2,max_(m<=n)[n log2+log B_nm]/(n h)). Each step contains finitely many genuine source norms.
sourceAllOrderRecipe.allOrderInference: This finite recipe and the strictly positive original h define the infinite diagonal sequence mathematically. A finite query materializes only its requested prefix and can fail its explicit representation budget.
sourceAllOrderRecipe.independence: The physical derivative loss 2*A+m is independent of n; the constants and selected scales depend on n and m.

tailArithmetic.selectedInequality: B_(n,m)*a_n^(-n*h)<=2^-n for every m<=n, with the original h>0.
tailArithmetic.support: chi(a_n*q) and all its derivatives vanish for a_n*q>=1; for a_n*q<=1/2, chi=1 and its positive derivatives vanish.
proof: The support restricts q<=1/a_n, hence B_(n,m)*q^(n*h)<=2^-n.
For n>J>=m and 0<q<=1, q^(n*h)<=q^((J+1)*h), since the ORIGINAL h is strictly positive.
The exact geometric series sum_(n>J)2^-n is 2^-J.
For q<1/(2*a_J), all terms n<=J lie on their actual unit plateaus, so the tail is the difference from the ORIGINAL uncut finite truncation.
Given fixed m and desired exponent N, a finite J with (J+1)*h>2*A+m+N exists; its possible enormous size is not rounded down.
tailArithmetic.localFiniteness: a_n>=2*a_(n-1) implies only finitely many nonzero cutoff terms on each compact q interval bounded away from0.
tailArithmetic.appliesTo: The velocity/potential tuple only after its actual source seminorm/selector premises have been supplied.

selection.tuple: Actual velocity and vector potential, including the radial cutoff commutator.

domain.sourceGeometryBound: The pinned positive h<2^-4096 is in particular <1/16. On every radius-1/2 complex disk centered at |eta|<=1, |1-2*h*z^2|>1/2. Cauchy gives |d_eta^j(1/L)|<=2*j!*2^j<=2*j!*8^j.
domain.sourceRegularity: The actual positive F/U are the original smooth inner solutions with the unchanged flat kappa and compact Ipos bumps. The independently source-bound M_X=U proof gives their smooth global average, including the axis and mass-closed zero branch.

averageBinding.theorem: The original average equals M_n/X for X>0, has its retained even core at X=0, and its final zero branch joins smoothly by the actual mass moment.

weights.extraPotentialIdentity: Replace the k-th chi Euler derivative by its k+1 derivative for s*chi_prime(s).
weights.pendingNorm: B_(n,m) must be computed from the actual normalized coefficient/potential jets multiplied by these weights, through all mixed profile derivatives <=m.
weights.selectorOnceNormExists: log(c_n) >= max(log(c_(n-1))+log2, [n*log2+log(max(1,B_(n,m)))]/(n*h), for every m<=n, plus the actual (5.37) requirements.
weights.allQProof: For 0<q<=1/c_n, B_(n,m)*q^(n*h)<=2^-n; for q>=1/c_n the cutoff and every derivative are zero.

rows.statement: Every Cartesian/time derivative through k of this actual cutoff velocity/potential tuple is <=B_nk*q^(2*n*h-(2*A+k)); the extra stream term is included.
rows.exactDerivativeLossBeforeBounding: Each physical word retains loss ell=a/2+D*b+c<=its length; only its coefficient magnitude is then majorized by baseLoss+length.
